tytul: Pumpkin butter: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for pumpkin butter.

ostrzezenia.tekst: NCHFP and University of Georgia Extension have no recommendation and no process for canning pumpkin butter at home.
Pumpkin is naturally a low-acid food for canning, with a pH above 4.6.
Home canning is not recommended for mashed or puréed pumpkin or winter squash.

akapity: According to an FDA table of approximate values, pumpkin has a pH of 4.8–5.2.

NCHFP says that even when vinegar or lemon juice is added, the pH of pumpkin butter varies so much that no single recommendation can be made to ensure a safe product; a large amount of sugar may also not be enough to inhibit pathogens.
Even if pumpkin butter were acidified to a pH below 4.6, its thick consistency would still need to be studied for how heat moves through the jar during processing.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for pumpkin butter from a checked source.
NCHFP says it is best to make pumpkin butter fresh for shorter storage in the refrigerator, or to freeze it.
